---
name: Contest a classification
about: A wallet is shown as linked and you believe the analysis is wrong
labels: dispute
---

<!--
Nothing here is adjudicated in private. The rules, the data and the evidence are
published under audit/ and recompute from a clone, so a dispute can be checked
by anyone — including you, before filing.

The detector has a measured error rate: against 308 wallets carrying a verifiable
independent history, the published rules remove 84 (27.3%). Being wrongly linked
is a known outcome, not an accusation of bad faith.
-->

**Wallet address**

**What the site currently shows** (group, tier, and the reason it cites)

**Why you believe it is wrong**
<!-- The most useful evidence is about the specific link: e.g. the cited funder
     is not yours, the shared amount is a coincidence, the wallet's history
     predates the game. Onchain facts are strongest — anyone can verify them. -->

**Version shown**
<!-- The release tag or date of the analysis you are looking at. Versions are
     immutable; a later version may already have changed this wallet's status. -->

<!--
Proving control of the wallet is not required to file, but a signed message from
the address is the only thing that establishes you are its holder, and any
override recorded as a result will say whether one was provided.
-->
